summary: Worker deployment limits cause silent poll failures that are implicitly retried without user awareness. When the 100-deployment limit is exceeded, the 101st deployment fails silently, degrading ergonomics since deployments are implicitly created but require explicit deletion.
userImpact: Users hitting the 100-deployment limit experience silent failures with only implicit poll retries, making it difficult to diagnose and recover from hitting deployment limits.
rootCause: Worker deployments are implicitly created on use but require explicit deletion, combined with silent failure on hitting the 100-deployment limit with only implicit poll retries.
proposedFix: Improve error communication beyond poll-failure warnings to explicitly notify users of deployment limit; implement automatic cleanup of ephemeral worker deployments in cloud tests.
keyQuote: when a user hits a worker deployment limit, it fails poll calls which are just implicitly retried forever
